The calculator is an Angular app (app-root, ng 11, assets from www.services.zh.ch/app/quest/tarifbestimmung/prod/) rendered inline in the section 'Tarifrechner Quellensteuer'. It is not in an iframe. No cookie banner appeared, so there was nothing to decline. Every control is a radio button. There are no dropdowns, free-text fields or date fields, so no dummy data was entered.

Page intro text (verbatim): 'Der Tarifrechner dient der Ermittlung des Quellensteuertarifs.' / 'Füllen Sie die Arbeitnehmendendaten wahrheitsgetreu aus und im Ergebnis erhalten Sie den Tarif für den Quellensteuerabzug.' / 'Die ausgewiesenen Tarife sind nicht rechtsverbindlich. …'. The accordion 'Nicht abgedeckte Fälle' lists: 'Gagen an Künstler, Sportler und Referenten', 'Verwaltungsratshonorare, welche an Personen mit Wohnsitz im Ausland bezahlt werden', 'Härtefälle', 'Renten und Kapitalleistungen aus Vorsorge'.
A visually hidden 'Beispiele' area shows the tags H3N and P3N. These were not clicked as inputs.

Child questions repeat for each child (input names child-1__…, child-2__…). The button 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' adds a child, and 'Kind löschen' removes one. The final tariff's digit equals the number of children whose 'Kind Ergebnis' digit is 1. For a single person, any child counted with H gives an H tariff (e.g. A1 + H1 -> H2N). A child is counted with H when it lives in the household and the person has sole custody or is the main financial contributor. While a child block is unanswered, the residence question Q16 is hidden.

Mapping seen for the residence/cross-border block: CH or 'Anderes Land' -> base tariff. DE with daily return and an Ansässigkeitsbescheinigung, or DE without daily return, return reasonable and no proof of more than 60 non-return days -> cross-border code (A->L, B->M, C->N, H->P, G->Q). Every other DE combination -> base tariff. LI -> 'Grundsätzlich keine Quellensteuerpflicht', except no daily return with more than 45 non-return days -> base tariff plus 'Unter Vorbehalt des Doppelbesteuerungsabkommens'. This block was explored exhaustively under the married + Y + 1 child (C1Y / C0Y) path and for Ersatzeinkünfte. For A/B/H it was spot-checked only via DE daily return + certificate (L0Y, L1N, M0N, M0Y, P1Y, P3N) and LI more than 45 days / Anderes Land (A0N).

The full cross-product of child paths × residence paths × confession × civil status was not enumerated (combinatorial). Child subtrees were enumerated fully with residence = Ja (Schweiz) for: married + partner employed + Y; married + partner not employed + N (Volljährig and not-in-household branches); single + N. The married + 'Minderjährig' + same household branch was fully crossed with all residence paths.

Not tested: more than 3 children (the upper limit of 'Ein weiteres Kind erfassen' is unknown); whether 'Kind löschen' recomputes correctly; tariff D or other special tariffs (none appeared in any path).
The answer value in V25–V29 summarises repeated per-child answers (Kind 1/2/3) because the schema allows one value per question id.
